decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed single storey rear extension because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of the Listed Building, number 20 The Butts and is complimentary to the visual amenity of the local area, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties or to the Conservation Area.  The development is in accordance with the adopted UDP Policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development), ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENVB 2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings of Local Townscape Character) and H 6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  8.30am  to 5pm on Mondays to Friday and 8.30 am  to 12.00 mid day on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of existing shed and w/c and the erection of a single storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
